column1: # Stemness signatures for d25_stemness.R. One row per (signature, gene).
# weight: numeric -> weighted scaled score; blank/NA for ALL genes -> unweighted mean z-score.
# Aliases resolved in d25 (KIAA0125<->FAM30A, NGFRAP1<->BEX3, GPR56<->ADGRG1, SMIM24<->C19orf77).
#  - vanGalen_HSC_Prog     : PRIMARY normal-HSC stemness. van Galen 2019 Table S3
#  - HSPC_core             : compact canonical HSC apex markers (fast sanity vs vanGalen_HSC_Prog).
#  - vanGalen_HSCprog_like : MALIGNANT HSC/Prog-like PROGRAM (van Galen Table S3 tumor-derived).
#                            Not "normal stemness" -- an LSC-state readout for the LSC definition.
#  - LSC17                 : BULK CONTROL ONLY (Ng 2016, weighted); biased on single cells.
